name: Naruto Kagami Stories
source: Follow the journey of Kagami Mio as he strives to become the greatest ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village. Along the way, he will face countless challenges—some external, and others tied to his own overwhelming power.
translation: Follow the journey of Kagami Mio as he strives to become the greatest ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village. Along the way, he will face countless challenges—some external, and others tied to his own overwhelming power.
